relationships.subject: Etv4
relationships.evidence_quote: this behavioral phenotype correlates with a significant reduction in the expression of the pain-transducing ion channel TRPV1 in mutant mice

relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: NGF regulates Etv4-dependent gene expression of molecules involved in extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling

key_findings: Etv4 ablation impairs peptidergic sensory projections and NGF-induced axonal elongation.
Etv4-null mice are less sensitive to noxious heat and chemical pain with reduced TRPV1 expression.
